_comment: 八境定义。英文译名一经确定即全库复用，不得在提示词中另造译法，否则英文模型上的成套感会断裂。

realms.elements_zh: 云海之上的白玉高台、九重丹陛、无梁金顶、终年不息的罡风
realms.elements_en: a white jade terrace above a sea of clouds, nine tiers of vermilion stone stairs, a beamless golden-roofed hall, ceaseless high wind
realms.short_en: a white jade terrace above a sea of clouds
realms.ornament_zh: 蟠龙抱柱、层叠飞檐、鎏金脊兽、云气纹栏板、斗拱彩画
realms.ornament_en: dragons coiling up the pillars, layered flying eaves, gilded ridge beasts, balustrade panels cut with swirling vapour scrollwork, painted dougong brackets

realms.elements_zh: 夯土层台、梯田式庭院、藏于山腹的暗殿、成排的谷仓
realms.elements_en: rammed-earth terraces, courtyards stepped like paddy fields, a dim hall buried in the mountain's belly, rows of granaries
realms.short_en: rammed-earth terraces stepped like paddy fields
realms.ornament_zh: 粟纹陶砖、素面石础、方直梁枋、无纹平栏、夯痕层叠
realms.ornament_en: grain-patterned fired brick, plain column bases, square unpainted beams, undecorated parapets, visible tamping seams

realms.elements_zh: 露天圆坛、高耸的青铜列柱、低压雷云
realms.elements_en: an open circular altar, tall bronze columns, a low ceiling of thunderheads
realms.short_zh: 雷云下的青铜露天圆坛
realms.short_en: an open bronze altar under thunderheads
realms.ornament_zh: 饕餮纹柱身、编钟成列、雷纹铺首、焦木斗拱、裂纹坛面
realms.ornament_en: taotie masks cast into the pillar shafts, ranked chime-bells, thunder-pattern door rings, charred timber brackets, a cracked pavement

realms.elements_zh: 极长的空廊、万千经幡、层叠的檐口
realms.elements_en: an impossibly long empty colonnade, thousands of prayer banners, tier upon tier of eaves
realms.short_en: an endless colonnade hung with banners
realms.ornament_zh: 镂空花窗、垂脊铁马、纱幔铜环、竹节纹柱、连绵挂落
realms.ornament_en: pierced lattice windows, iron wind-bells at the ridge ends, bronze rings for the gauze, shafts cut like bamboo joints, an unbroken carved valance

realms.elements_zh: 下沉式水院、深潭、暗渠水帘、湿滑苔石
realms.elements_en: a sunken water courtyard, a deep pool, culverts and hanging water curtains, slick mossy stone
realms.short_en: a sunken water court around a deep pool
realms.ornament_zh: 螭首吐流、江崖海浪纹栏板、苔痕石阶、暗渠石雕、水磨青砖
realms.ornament_en: marble dragon-head spouts, balustrade panels cut with the wave-and-cliff motif, moss-stained steps, carved culvert mouths, polished grey brick

realms.elements_zh: 长明灯阵、朱漆廊柱、幽深的内殿
realms.elements_en: ranks of eternal oil lamps, vermilion-lacquered columns, a deep inner hall
realms.short_en: a hall of eternal lamps and vermilion columns
realms.ornament_zh: 琉璃脊兽、铜镜嵌壁、彩画梁枋、藻井、朱漆剔花
realms.ornament_en: glazed ceramic ridge beasts, bronze mirrors set into the walls, polychrome-painted beams, a coffered caisson ceiling, carved red lacquer

realms.elements_zh: 巨石门阙、绝壁栈道、石阶尽头、苍松
realms.elements_en: a colossal stone gateway, a plank road pinned to a sheer cliff, a stair that ends at nothing, ancient pines
realms.short_en: a colossal stone gateway on a cliff
realms.ornament_zh: 蟠龙石柱、抱鼓石、界碑篆刻、门额石匾、凿痕未磨的条石
realms.ornament_en: pillars wound with coiled dragons, drum-shaped gate blocks, a boundary stele in seal script, a carved lintel plaque, ashlar still showing the chisel

realms.elements_zh: 荷池与曲桥、临水回廊、莲与锦鲤、支在水上的敞厅
realms.elements_en: a lotus pond and zigzag bridge, a covered walk along the water, lotus and koi, an open hall on stilts
realms.short_en: a lotus pond with a zigzag bridge
realms.ornament_zh: 望柱莲花头、栏板浮雕、檐下挂落、锦鲤浮雕、临水美人靠
realms.ornament_en: newel posts capped with carved buds, balustrade panels in low relief, a carved valance under the eaves, koi worked into the stone, a curved railing bench

global_anchors.aspect: 双版本：3:4 竖版（发布）与 16:9 横版（封面/视觉冲击）
global_anchors.render_zh: 照相写实 CG 电影剧照，大气透视，微观细节，轻微胶片颗粒
global_anchors.render_en: photoreal cinematic still, deep atmospheric perspective, fine micro-detail, subtle film grain
global_anchors.composition: 暗前景框 + 上下二分（上卦占上方，下卦占下方） + 远景消隐
global_anchors.camera: 平视远眺，地平线在画面中下部；不用低机位仰视——仰视看不到云海地平线，宏大感就没了
global_anchors.creature: 远景小点，不露脸，默认丹顶鹤
global_anchors.text: 图上不渲染文字，顶部约 1/5 留白供后期排卦名与卦辞
global_anchors.exposure_zh: 整体明亮通透，雾气本身被光点亮、是画面最亮的区域；暗部开放保留细节，不压死黑
global_anchors.exposure_en: bright luminous overall exposure, the mist itself lit from within and forming the brightest zone of the picture, shadows open and full of detail, no crushed blacks
global_anchors.scale_zh: 建筑体量极大，上境向画面顶部之外继续升高；灵禽小如尘点，仅作尺度对照；纵深不少于四层，最远层没入光里
global_anchors.scale_en: immense architectural scale, the upper realm continuing up beyond the top edge of the frame, the birds reduced to specks purely for scale, at least four receding depth layers, the furthest lost in light
global_anchors.negative_space_zh: 建筑约占画面三成，天空与云海占七成。留白即宏大，把画面填满会杀死空间感
global_anchors.negative_space_en: architecture occupies roughly a third of the frame, open sky and cloud sea the rest; the emptiness is what makes it vast, a filled frame kills the sense of space
global_anchors.vista_zh: 云海一路延伸至地平线；地平线附近另有一座极小的建筑作二次尺度参照
global_anchors.vista_en: the cloud sea runs unbroken to a distant horizon, with a second far smaller structure near that horizon as a secondary scale reference
global_anchors.float_zh: 建筑悬空不着地，浮于云海之上；巨瀑自平台边缘倾泻，落入云中不见底
global_anchors.float_en: the architecture floats free above the cloud sea with no ground beneath it, and a colossal waterfall pours off the platform edge into cloud with no visible bottom
global_anchors.foreground_zh: 前景是受光的精细浮雕——白玉栏板、螭首、磨光石地面，是全画细节最密处，不是黑剪影
global_anchors.foreground_en: the foreground is sunlit high-relief carving — marble balustrade panels, dragon-head spouts, polished stone paving — the densest detail in the picture, never a black silhouette
global_anchors.figures_zh: 3-5 个极小的袍服人影立于栏边或堤道，其中一人着橙红衣袍作点缀；此尺寸下五官不成像
global_anchors.figures_en: three to five tiny robed figures at the balustrade or on the causeway, one in orange, far too small for facial features to resolve
